scope: Reviewed instrumentation/graph/census/tests and raw02 results before new PNG critique. Independently ran seven mechanism/regression tests; no browser/model inference or new source decoding executed by critic. Frozen labels/protocol/product unchanged.

protocolCautionDispositions.detail: unreachedComponents operates precisely on active AND loose-reached AND NOT strictly-reached vertices; components exclude roots/strict vertices.

rootReach reconstructs deterministic BFS with fresh queue from automatic roots and fixed neighbor order. It never interprets overwritten original root-census queue; recomputed strict masks/parents equal captured originals.

firstFailure and firstFrontier both stored; status ALREADY_STRICTLY_REACHABLE explicit. Test preserves failed chosen loose route even when alternate strict route reaches target. These are witnesses, not unique physical/global cuts.
Raw-directed vs actual-pruned BFS uses identical active/root masks within each version. All recorded raw/pruned reach sets agree in this corpus; pruning does not explain observed reach losses here.

Nearest active sample selected after all automatic measurements; ascending pixel scan plus strict lower distance comparison gives deterministic lowest-index exact ties. Engineering uncertainty and route status retained. Not confirmed same hair or a detector seed.
firstRemoval includes route step and wasRoot, with actual bilateral bilinear contributors/weights/responses/bestIndex/rawActive. This describes selected-route deletion, not a proposed gap bridge.

Every capture anchor requires exactly one occurrence. Synthetic test compares all original public fields and input nonmutation. Census compares returned arrays/traces/diagnostics exactly to original function, archived browser fields numerically, and BFS masks/parents exactly.

remainingLimits: Directed orientation failure can be a legitimate rejection of a crossing/branch/texture route; do not lower.85 or alignment floor because a manual nearby ending exists.
Counts are frontier neighbor-pair witnesses with co-occurring gates, not mutually exclusive causal percentages, hair counts or precision/recall.
Inactive targets use pixelFacts reasons rather than meaningless zero-direction edge histograms; active-edge angle facts still describe grid responses, not anatomical tangents.
A failed chosen route may have earlier failures inside still-strictly-reachable vertices; firstFailure can precede firstFrontier.
All components and first3 representative display choices are deterministic diagnostics, not certified fibers or endpoints.
